answers.1:
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: pvc-local
  namespace: $NS
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
EOF
answers.2:
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: pvc-pod
  namespace: $NS
spec:
  containers:
  - name: nginx
    image: nginx
    volumeMounts:
    - name: data-vol
      mountPath: /data
  volumes:
  - name: data-vol
    persistentVolumeClaim:
      claimName: pvc-local
EOF
